name: Agricultural Marketing Infrastructure (AMI)
eligibility_facts: individuals, agri-preneurs, farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, state agencies and others listed in source
questions: What infrastructure do you want to create—storage, cold storage, processing, or market infrastructure?
Are you applying as an individual, farmer group/FPO, cooperative, or business?
temporal_note: Source says the sub-scheme continued till 31.03.2026; as of the current date this source is stale for current availability. Refresh before showing as open.

eligibilityCriteria.source_text: individuals, agri-preneurs, farmers, FPOs, cooperatives, state agencies and others listed in source

question.en: Are you an individual, agri-preneur, farmer, FPO, cooperative, state agency, or another applicant type listed by AMI?
question.or: ଆପଣ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତି, କୃଷି ଉଦ୍ୟୋଗୀ, ଚାଷୀ, FPO, ସମବାୟ, ରାଜ୍ୟ ସଂସ୍ଥା କିମ୍ବା AMIରେ ତାଲିକାଭୁକ୍ତ ଅନ୍ୟ ଆବେଦକ ଶ୍ରେଣୀର କି?

description.en: The project requires financing and appraisal for a credit-linked, back-ended subsidy; this must be confirmed with the financing institution.
description.or: ଏହା ଋଣ-ସଂଯୁକ୍ତ ପରବର୍ତ୍ତୀ ସବସିଡି ହେତୁ ପ୍ରକଳ୍ପର ଅର୍ଥାୟନ ଏବଂ ମୂଲ୍ୟାଙ୍କନ ଆବଶ୍ୟକ; ଅର୍ଥାୟନ ସଂସ୍ଥା ସହ ଏହା ଯାଞ୍ଚ କରିବାକୁ ପଡ଼ିବ।
